stylePrompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: fantasy RPG inventory icon. Generate ONE icon for SUBJECT. References are STYLE ONLY: match hand-painted farm icons with broad visible brush facets, rich natural colors, dimensional soft upper-left lighting and crisp readable silhouette. Center entire object in square canvas with 8% empty margin, large simple masses readable at 43px. Truly transparent background. No backdrop, frame, letters, numbers, watermark or cast shadow. No extra objects.
